decision: This authorized campaign preserves complete text records and lossless per-original-journal field exports for eight measured requests. Measured complete request text is 24.5MB gzip and journal export is68.7MB gzip. Use one explicit scoped128MiB aggregate evidence budget, rather than omitting essential recoverable traces or dividing them into small commits. Each independently recorded original journal remains whole; no original file or payload is chunked to meet the per-file limit. Combined exports exceeding10MiB remain external. Ordinary authored material retains20MiB aggregate guard. This does not change ongoing limits or include weights, binaries or downloaded sources.
